CA.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates) is explicitly linked to an origin/process entry for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: The report separately lists identified content (red/blue coordinates) and an origin/status field for the same referent/time, meeting C, O and D.

A.rationale: An explicit process/origin entry links a generation/processing condition to the named content representation.

C.rationale: The text identifies specific content instances (red and blue coordinate sets) with explicit referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Content identity (blue coordinates) is presented separately from an origin/status field, showing differentiated status attribution.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/represented_time entry describes how this content is presented/emerges/is represented (access provenance).
